continuity: The Sudden Quest requiring Taekyung to take only half of the internal energy he digests is accepted and completed; Taekyung absorbs half of the mysterious qi mass in Team Leader Choi's dantian.
Team Leader Choi completes his first complete circulation of the Jin Family's Cultivation Technique, becomes a martial artist, gains direct control of his mana, and nearly doubles his mana reserves.

Taekyung's internal energy reaches 100 years, the Fire Gate Divine Technique reaches Seven Stars, he gains the Title I'm a Master, completes the Repeat Quest Back, Back—Let's See Your Back!, and levels up.
Taekyung nearly achieves Three Flowers Gather at the Crown but fails to enter the Supreme Peak realm; the reason for the failed breakthrough remains unknown.
Taekyung intends to guide and digest the internal energy of Butler Kim, Im Kkeokjeong, and Song Song next.
plot: Jin Taekyung accepts the Sudden Quest requiring him to take only half of the internal energy he digests and uses Scorching Yang Qi to attack the mysterious qi mass in Team Leader Choi's dantian. He absorbs half of the mass while guiding the remainder, enabling Choi to complete his first complete circulation of the Jin Family's Cultivation Technique. Choi becomes a martial artist, gains free control over his mana, and nearly doubles his mana reserves.

Taekyung's absorption raises his internal energy to 100 years, advances the Fire Gate Divine Technique to Seven Stars, grants him the Title I'm a Master, completes both Quests, and produces a level-up. He nearly achieves Three Flowers Gather at the Crown and enters the Supreme Peak realm, but the breakthrough fails just before completion. He then decides to try the same process on Butler Kim, Im Kkeokjeong, and Song Song, causing the Repeat Quest Back, Back—Let's See Your Back! to appear again as the three retreat in fear.

Retain "jiazi" for 갑자 and render the Battle of Myeongnyang reference with its established historical name.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung, Team Leader Choi, Butler Kim, Song Song, and Im Kkeokjeong remain committed to the Peace Guild despite its coming conflict with Ares Guild.
Taekyung intends to make the Peace Guild strong enough to confront Ares Guild rather than abandon it under pressure.
Ares Guild officially has more than one hundred A-rank Hunters besides Lee Jungryong, countless mid- and low-rank Hunters, and additional undisclosed forces.
Song Song remains with the Peace Guild after requesting double pay and hazard compensation.
Im Kkeokjeong chooses to continue as a Hunter after recovering from his injuries, though his actual return to field work is not yet confirmed.
Taekyung possesses Martial Arts Manual Creation, which requires Great Completion in the martial art and physical materials.
Taekyung created a Peak-grade Jin Family's Cultivation Technique manual after investing Intelligence points to reach the required threshold of 100.
Team Leader Choi and Butler Kim recognized Taekyung's manual as a Mana Cultivation Method.
Taekyung's claim that his late father taught him the technique as a family health regimen is a deliberate cover story; the actual origin of his cultivation method remains unknown.
Lee Jungryong regards Cheon Taemin as an older brother despite their lack of blood relation.
Taekyung has begun secretly teaching the Jin Family's Cultivation Technique to the four Peace Guild members present, starting with Team Leader Choi.
The Jin Family's Cultivation Technique is a Peak martial art with slow qi accumulation, exceptional stability, and mana control on an entirely different level from ordinary methods.
Team Leader Choi is a B-rank Hunter with unusually abundant and clean energy and unusually strong physical foundations despite lacking a Mana Cultivation Method.
Taekyung intends to raise Team Leader Choi to the Peak realm.
The Jin Family's Cultivation Technique is now being used on Team Leader Choi; he has completed his first complete circulation and can freely control his mana.

Taekyung accepted and completed the Sudden Quest concerning half of the internal energy he digested, absorbed half of the mysterious qi mass in Choi's dantian, and reached 100 years of internal energy.
Taekyung gained the Title I'm a Master, advanced the Fire Gate Divine Technique to Seven Stars, completed the Repeat Quest Back, Back—Let's See Your Back!, and leveled up.
Taekyung nearly achieved Three Flowers Gather at the Crown but failed to enter the Supreme Peak realm and now plans to attempt the process on the other three people present.
open_questions: Who actually taught Jin Taekyung the Jin Family's Cultivation Technique?
What history led Lee Jungryong to regard the unrelated Cheon Taemin as his older brother?
How extensive are Ares Guild's undisclosed forces beyond its officially registered Hunters?
Will Im Kkeokjeong's reattached arms recover sufficiently for him to return to Hunter work?
What is the origin of the large qi mass in Team Leader Choi's dantian?
What prevented Taekyung from completing his breakthrough into the Supreme Peak realm?
Will Taekyung's attempt to guide the other three people's energy produce the same result?
